web_events.query: US economic data release this week CPI GDP jobs
web_events.answer: This week's US economic data releases include the August jobs report, which showed 162,000 new jobs created, the highest since March, and the August Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which was in-line with expectations but still indicates inflation above the Federal Reserve's 2% target. Additionally, the August Producer Price Index (PPI) and weekly jobless claims for the week ending September 12 will be released.
